critical_code_review_comments: FIXED in this iteration: /app/backend/server.py line ~1551 — embed_captions branch used os.replace() between /app/backend/uploads and /tmp which are separate filesystems in this container (EXDEV: Invalid cross-device link). Replaced with shutil.move() and placed captioned_output under output_path.parent so the move stays on the same filesystem.

Minor: Default voice_id 'alloy' triggers ElevenLabs 404 (voice_not_found) and silently falls back to gTTS. Not blocking exports, but consider validating voice_id at upload time or seeding ElevenLabs voice catalog so users get a clear error instead of silent fallback.
Minor: passlib bcrypt warning on backend startup ('module bcrypt has no attribute __about__') — cosmetic, but worth pinning bcrypt<5 or upgrading passlib to remove the trapped exception spam.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cross-device-link bug in CC burn-in was the root cause of the previously reported 'MP4 export silently fails / no download' P0. After shutil.move fix, the full pipeline (analyze -> export with embed_captions=true -> auto-download via blob anchor) works end-to-end with no console errors. Playwright must use page.expect_download() (not toast assertions) to truly verify downloads — confirmed working. window.confirm() in Delete Forever requires page.on('dialog', accept) handler. Test user tester1@gappylabs.com is PRO tier with 50-video quota.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/backend/server.py embed_captions branch wrote captioned MP4 to UPLOADS_DIR (/app/backend/uploads, overlay fs) and then called os.replace() to rename it onto the export output_path which lives in /tmp (tmpfs). os.replace == rename(2), which fails with EXDEV (errno 18) when source and destination are on different filesystems. FastAPI then returned 500, frontend showed 'Video export failed' toast and never reached downloadExportedVideo. Reproduction: POST /api/export/{id} with embed_captions=true on this container. Mitigation applied: (a) write captioned_output to output_path.parent (same fs), (b) use shutil.move (handles EXDEV via copy+unlink fallback) instead of os.replace. Verified: backend log now shows 'Captions embedded successfully' and download returns 132KB valid MP4.
